s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain and gastrointestinal bleeding with a mass in the small intestine
salient_findings: exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

raw.syndrome_frame: intermittent abdominal pain and gastrointestinal bleeding with a mass in the small intestine

key_facts: normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening on magnetic resonance enterography
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy on exploratory laparotomy
polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass on gross examination
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells on microscopic examination
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 on immunohistochemical analysis

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Strong S100 protein and SOX10 positivity, and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Transmural, infiltrative proliferation and mesenteric lymphadenopathy

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Strong S100 protein positivity and spindle cell morphology

shortlist.label: Clear cell sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar immunohistochemical profile and small intestinal location

shortlist.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Nested and fascicular patterns, and patchy synaptophysin expression

raw.rationale: The tumor's transmural, infiltrative growth pattern, uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, and strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 are consistent with a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Presence of high mitotic activity and atypical features not typical of schwannoma

rejected.label: Clear cell sarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of melanin pigment and HMB45/Melan A positivity, and different clinical context

rejected.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
rejected.why: Negative chromogranin and CD56 immunohistochemistry, and different morphological features
